reviews.author: Justavisitor
reviews.text: The staff is really, really unfriendly. It's not obvious that I hate foreigners, and I don't try to hide it at all. It was the worst service!!! If I could give it a negative rating I would! If you are a foreigner, be careful. The cashier is rude and unfriendly to foreigners!!!! I have to close the store or fire the cashier. I think he doesn't want to be there! When guests come in, they don't even say hello, and when they talk to them in English, they just sigh and respond in Korean, without even showing any signs of effort. I bought a few things at that store, and the store owner just took the inventory order form and slammed it in front of me at the checkout counter. When selling clothes, there is no quality inspection at all. I bought a pair of pants, and I thought they had inspected the quality because they were put in a ziplock bag, but when I got home, there was a hole in them. So I went to return it the next day, and they said I couldn't exchange or return it without a receipt. When I told him I bought it yesterday, he said in Korean, “How can I remember?” As a former retail worker, I can understand not remembering the faces of customers who come into the store and leave without buying anything, but since you have to talk to customers and process transactions, shouldn't it be easy to remember who bought something? I don't know if the employee doesn't want to exchange/return, or if he has a short memory. As a retail store employee, having a short memory is never a good trait. I kept saying that I had a hole in my pants and wanted to exchange them for new ones, but the employee kept showing me the price of the pants on the calculator and thought I wanted a refund. So I kept saying “exchange” and “exchange” with hand gestures and foot gestures, but eventually he understood and pointed to the pants on the shelf and said that those pants were out of stock and that I could only exchange them for other pants that other people had tried on. I had no choice but to pick up the pants and give them to her, but she just roughly folded them and left them on the counter. No envelope, no apology! So I just grabbed my pants and left. I will never come here again and I will never recommend it to others.

reviews.author: Elissa Huang

I really wanted to make a couple ring with my boyfriend, and I finally got to make it in Korea. I'm really glad I found this place. Using real lab-grown diamonds and the highest quality materials, you can create a ring that will last a lifetime.

The entire process took about an hour, and you can receive the final ring in just three days.

The entire process was conducted in English, so there was no language barrier at all, and the production team was very friendly and helpful.

Highly recommended to anyone looking for a memorable ring making experience. I'm really glad I chose this place over other places. They are truly experienced jewelers who do not compromise on quality.🫶🏻
